fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls a target at or below 30% health for 28 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.4 times the damage they had left, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Vise Grip
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike deals 9 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 50% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Jaws
fusions.desc: Conjures a pair of jaws onto the nearest enemy that arm after 1 second and wait up to 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 3 tiles springs them, which deals 24 damage to everything within 2 tiles of them and leaves it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mudbank Watcher
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded crocodile that fights beside you. Every 2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 6 damage, and anything it bites moves 50% slower for 2.5 seconds.
